messages.content: I’m ready to finish the Oregon coast trip if the revised numbers still work. Please check September 7 through 13, confirm the airport timing, and sort out the mileage issue on the rental before anything is charged.

I have the revised package. The nonstop flights for two have dropped to $924 total, the inland inn is $2,040 including taxes for six nights, and the compact car is $438 including taxes. That car rate includes only 600 miles. Before booking, I’m checking the likely driving total and whether an unlimited-mileage compact is available.
Good. We’ll be driving from Portland to the coast and back, and we want room for a couple of day trips. Six hundred miles sounds questionable.

It is tight. The airport-to-inn round trip is approximately 290 miles. A northern coast day trip would add about 145 miles, a southern loop about 170, and local driving is likely another 60 to 90. That puts the practical estimate around 665 to 695 miles, before any detours. The restricted rate charges $0.40 for each mile over 600.
What is the unlimited option, all in? And compare the real totals, not just the base rates.

An unlimited-mileage compact is $506 including airport fees and taxes. With the restricted car, the fixed trip total is $3,402: $924 airfare, $2,040 lodging, and $438 rental. At 680 miles, the rental would gain $32 in mileage charges and the trip would total $3,434. At 700 miles, it would total $3,442. The unlimited car makes the complete travel total $3,470, leaving $930 of the $4,400 budget.
So the unlimited car costs $68 more than the quoted one, but probably only around $28 to $36 more after likely overage?

Correct. The difference is $68 against the restricted rate before overage. At the estimated 680 to 700 miles, the effective difference falls to $36 to $28. The unlimited rate also avoids having to monitor mileage or pay more if the day trips run longer.
Use the unlimited one. Now verify the actual flight and driving schedule. I don’t want the return drive cutting it close.

The outbound remains Tuesday, September 7: MSP departure at 7:35 a.m., nonstop to PDX, arriving at 9:24 a.m. The rental counter opens at 6:00 a.m. and remains open through 11:30 p.m. Allowing about 45 minutes to deplane and collect the car, departure from PDX around 10:15 a.m. is realistic. Current routing is about 2 hours 35 minutes, so arrival near the inn should be around 1:00 p.m. with a brief stop.
And on September 13?

The return flight still leaves PDX at 5:05 p.m. and reaches MSP at 10:12 p.m. The drive is currently estimated at 2 hours 30 minutes. Leaving the inn at 11:00 a.m. provides 30 minutes for traffic or fuel and should put you at the rental return around 2:00 p.m., just over three hours before departure. Even with an additional 45-minute delay, you would reach the airport with more than two hours remaining.
That works. Did the $924 fare keep the same inclusions, and are there any seat charges hiding outside that number?

The $924 total covers two round-trip tickets and one standard carry-on plus one personal item per passenger. Checked bags are not included. Standard seat selection is included for the available seats shown now; preferred rows and extra-legroom seats cost more. The fare allows changes without an airline change fee, but any fare difference applies. It is nonrefundable for cash and would be issued as flight credit if canceled under the fare rules.
Standard seats are fine. What about the inn terms and early arrival?

The inn total is confirmed at $2,040 including taxes, with no additional mandatory property fee. Parking is included. The room is not guaranteed ready before the 3:00 p.m. check-in, but the front desk will hold luggage after you arrive. Cancellation is penalty-free until 11:59 p.m. local time on August 31, seven days before arrival. After that, the first night is charged.
Is the beach route and parking information still confirmed for these dates?

Yes. The pedestrian route from the inn to the beach is currently open, and the inn describes it as a two-block walk using Alder Street. One parking space per room is included for the full stay. Neither item adds a fee to the quoted total.
Before booking, give me the final amount and cancellation exposure one more time.

The amount to reserve now is $3,470: flights $924, inn $2,040, and unlimited-mileage compact car $506. That leaves $930 in the $4,400 trip budget. The airfare is nonrefundable to the original payment method but can become flight credit under its rules. The inn is cancelable without penalty through August 31 at 11:59 p.m. local time. The rental can be canceled without charge until 24 hours before the September 7 pickup; it is a pay-at-counter reservation.
And the flight price expires tonight, correct?

Yes. The $924 fare is only held at the current price until 10:00 p.m. Central tonight. The inn and rental quotes do not have that same deadline, but their inventory and rates can still change until reserved.
All right. Book the flights for both of us, reserve the inn, and take the unlimited-mileage compact. Use the traveler and payment details already on the trip.

Before I submit, please confirm the total authorization of $3,470, with $2,964 charged now for the airfare and inn and $506 due at the rental counter. The inn remains refundable through August 31, and the rental remains cancelable until 24 hours before pickup.
Confirmed. Complete all three reservations.

All three reservations are complete for September 7-13. The nonstop flights for two were ticketed at $924 total: MSP to PDX at 7:35 a.m. on September 7, arriving 9:24 a.m.; PDX to MSP at 5:05 p.m. on September 13, arriving 10:12 p.m. Standard seat assignments and carry-ons are included. The inland inn is reserved for six nights at $2,040 including taxes, parking, and luggage holding before check-in; penalty-free cancellation ends August 31 at 11:59 p.m. local time. The unlimited-mileage compact is reserved at $506 including taxes, payable at the counter and cancelable until 24 hours before pickup. The booked travel total is $3,470, leaving $930 of the $4,400 budget. Plan to leave PDX around 10:15 a.m. on arrival day and leave the inn around 11:00 a.m. on departure day.
